name: Mautic Content Provider
description: Expose nodes and views as clean HTML for Mautic emails.
project_description:
This module provides a way to expose Drupal content to Mautic for use in email template etc.

 IMPORTANT: Requires the " Drupal Integrated Content " Mautic plugin to be enabled on your Mautic installation. 

 Features 
 
 Exposes a selection of nodes in a selection of view modes. 
 Adds a views display type specifically for Mautic output. 
 
 Post-Installation 
 Configuration at /admin/config/services/mautic-content-provider.

 Additional Requirements 
 For the exposed content to be usable in your Mautic installation, you will need the "Drupal Integrated Content" Mautic plugin.
